title: A bit of practice before you start the game
para1: Please ask the experimenter if you have any clarifying question, and when you’re ready, have a few practice sessions to familiarize yourself with the game. Your choices in those sessions won’t be recorded.
para2: You’ll notice that the pace of the game is fast. Please make sure you keep the pace as after {{missed_trials}} missed trials, the game stops automatically, and if that happened you would not get any earnings.
